heard: Alan Shepard never hit a golf ball for Miles. During Apollo 14, he dropped two golf balls into lunar dust. Shepard attached a Wilson 6-iron head to a rock collection tool. His bulky, rigid spacesuit forced him to swing with one hand. On camera, Shepard exclaimed that his second shot flew Miles and Miles. Experts checked the drive using digitally enhanced photo analysis in 2021. His first golf ball traveled approximately 24 yards. His second shot reached only about 40 yards. That legendary swing never launched anything for miles.
